item.title: A Mashup Of 'Money In The Grave' And 'Last Christmas' Is TikTok's Song Of The Christmas Season
item.description: Money In the Grave x Last Christmas or Money In the Sleigh is a mashup of the songs "Money In the Grave" by Drake and "Last Christmas" by Wham! produced by TikToker and DJ @noteliwood. The song was released on TikTok in mid-November 2025 and became notably popular as an original sound over the following weeks, with a second original sound consisting of the song gaining similar popularity that December. The song is often used over Christmas-themed dance and meme videos.

item.title: Couples Show Off Their Babies And Puppies With Katt Williams's 'Whose White Baby Is That' Audio
item.description: Whose Goddamn White Baby Is That? is a memorable quote spoken by Katt Williams's character Darren in the 2014 movie School Dance. In the movie, Darren's love interest, played by Tiffany Haddish, brings two children, including a white baby, to prison to visit him and he says, "Whose goddamn white baby is that?" In December 2019, TikToker @tygerty_929 uploaded a "lip dub": video set to the scene's audio, which became a popular original sound for further lip dub videos over the following years. Man

item.title: '89' Is The Latest In a Series of Number Memes That Followed '67,' But This Time, It's the Adults Spamming The Emote
item.description: 89 Meme refers to a variation of the 67 memes, where people wave their hands sideways or with their palms facing down as a way of parodying the viral 67 meme.

item.title: No, This Bunny Walking With A Candle Is Not From 'Animal Croissing,' Her Name Is Umi From 'Rental'
item.description: Umi Walking With a Candle refers to a GIF of the bunny character Umi from the Steam indie horror game "Rental" nervously walking down a dark hallway with a candle.

item.title: This BanBan GIF Has Been Used To Mourn Lost Media, Both Real And Not, Since 2023
item.description: X Is… Lost Media or BanBan Crying is a reaction meme format using the phrasal template, "X is… lost media?," "X" being a given subject, alongside a reaction GIF of BanBan from Garten of BanBan putting his tongue in his mouth and crying. The GIF originates from an April 2023 video by YouTuber Horror Skunx and the meme was popularized as early as August of that year. The meme is often used to ironically to falsely claim that something is now lost media.

item.title: Based 'Fire Duck' Is Still One Of The More Wicked Animal Photos On The Web
item.description: Goose on Fire, also known as Fire Duck, is a perfectly timed photograph of a goose running in front of a campfire, appearing as if its head is aflame due to the perspective the picture was taken from.
